title: This ‘Punk Motherf**ker’ Angered Police in the Worst Way Possible
description:
A known criminal that New Mexico police officers called “another mistake of this f***ing town” decided he was going cause chaos on a random Wednesday in Las Cruces. Cody Jimenez, a repeat offender, pleaded guilty to three charges in connection with this wild incident caught on bodycam.
